title: Render structured developer logs and capture selected console streams
body: Compose with an application-owned tracing subscriber. Support log records and a Rust formatting macro named sparrow_eprintln! with captured identifiers. Present time, severity, target, message and fields in a scannable layout. Indent continuations, respect NO_COLOR and make redirected diagnostics readable. Preserve typed fields, span context and the stdout or stderr identity at intake. Offer explicit writers and tee selected child streams. Worker-driven output keeps slow terminal and transport I/O off the ordinary call path. Verify a single local display and single structured event, redirection and a slow sink.
